name: Hudson Bros Trailer Mfg., Inc.
old_description: Hudson Trailer Manufacturing is a family-owned manufacturer of a full line of flat bed trailers, dump trailers, car haulers, tilt trailers, utility and landscape trailers that was established in 1970 and is celebrating 55+ years of manufacturing.
about:
Hudson Bros Trailer Mfg., Inc. operates from Denton, North Carolina, where the family-owned business was established in 1970 by the Hudson brothers. Now celebrating more than 55 years of continuous manufacturing, the company remains at 6542 NC 47, Denton, NC 27239.

The company produces a full line of trailers including flatbeds, dump trailers, car haulers, tilt trailers, and utility and landscape models. Its Pro Series represents the premium equipment trailer line, offered in configurations such as gooseneck, deckover tilt, air brake, deckover, fender tilt, and heavy-duty deckover variants. The Dump Trailer Series comes in 6-by-12-foot (3-ton) and 7-by-14-foot (6-ton) sizes with options like scissor lifts, combination gates, ramps, and tarp kits. Standard features on Pro Series units include Dexter axles, radial tires, and adjustable couplers. The facility also houses a full-service parts department that ships nationwide and a repair shop for trailer service needs.

Hudson Trailers sells primarily through a dealer network and directly to end users across the United States. Customers range from equipment contractors and landscapers to individual haulers, though the company does not publicly list specific industry verticals. Thousands of Pro Series trailers are reported in use nationwide.

The company emphasizes 100 percent compliance with all federal regulations, a one-year warranty on the Pro Series, and a reputation for quality and workmanship that it says stands second to none. The business was built on providing dealers with the highest quality products and service in the industry.
